datasets.name: ds_active_devices
queryLines: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list WHERE status = 'Active'

datasets.name: ds_total_readings
queryLines: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log

datasets.name: ds_total_alerts
queryLines: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.alerts

datasets.name: ds_top_devices
queryLines: SELECT d.device_name, COUNT(*) as total_readings FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log s JOIN workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list d ON s.imei = d.imei GROUP BY d.device_name ORDER BY total_readings DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_monthly_volume
queryLines: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', data_timestamp) as month, COUNT(*) as total_readings, COUNT(DISTINCT imei) as active_devices FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_alert_type
queryLines: SELECT alert_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.alerts GROUP BY alert_type

datasets.name: ds_top_alerts
queryLines: SELECT d.device_name, a.alert_type, COUNT(*) as alert_count FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.alerts a JOIN workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list d ON a.uid = d.uid GROUP BY d.device_name, a.alert_type ORDER BY alert_count DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_daily_alerts
queryLines: SELECT report_date, alert_type, COUNT(*) as alert_count FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.alerts GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_top_consumption
queryLines: SELECT d.device_name, ROUND(SUM(t.daily_consumption), 2) as total_consumption FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.totalizer t JOIN workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list d ON t.uid = d.uid WHERE t.daily_consumption > 0 AND t.daily_consumption < 1e9 GROUP BY d.device_name ORDER BY total_consumption DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_stale_devices
queryLines: WITH last_seen AS (SELECT imei, MAX(data_timestamp) AS last_reading FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log GROUP BY imei) SELECT d.device_name, d.location_name, d.site_code, ls.last_reading, DATEDIFF(DAY, ls.last_reading, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS days_since_last_reading FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list d LEFT JOIN last_seen ls ON d.imei = ls.imei WHERE d.status = 'Active' AND (ls.last_reading IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(DAY, ls.last_reading, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) > 7) ORDER BY days_since_last_reading DESC LIMIT 30

datasets.name: ds_hourly
queryLines: SELECT HOUR(data_timestamp) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as reading_count FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_site_readings
queryLines: SELECT d.site_code, COUNT(*) as total_readings FROM workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log s JOIN workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list d ON s.imei = d.imei GROUP BY d.site_code ORDER BY total_readings DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_data_way
queryLines:
SELECT
  data_way,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log
GROUP BY
  data_way

datasets.name: ds_distinct_devices
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT imei) as total
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log

datasets.name: ds_expiring_service
queryLines:
SELECT
  device_name,
  location_name,
  service_expiry_date,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, CURRENT_DATE(), service_expiry_date) as days_until_expiry
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list
WHERE
  service_expiry_date IS NOT NULL
  AND service_expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 90)
ORDER BY
  service_expiry_date
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_avg_consumption
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(daily_consumption), 2) as avg_daily
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.totalizer
WHERE
  daily_consumption > 0
  AND daily_consumption < 1e9

datasets.name: ds_app_type
queryLines:
SELECT
  application_type,
  COUNT(*) as device_count
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list
WHERE
  application_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  application_type
ORDER BY
  device_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_monthly_consumption
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', report_date) as month,
  parameter_name,
  ROUND(SUM(daily_consumption), 2) as total_consumption
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.totalizer
WHERE
  daily_consumption > 0
  AND daily_consumption < 1e9
GROUP BY
  1,
  2
ORDER BY

datasets.name: ds_avg_flow
queryLines:
SELECT
  d.device_name,
  ROUND(AVG(s.p1), 3) as avg_flow
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.sensor_log s
    JOIN workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list d
      ON s.imei = d.imei
WHERE
  s.p1 > 0
  AND s.p1 < 10000
GROUP BY
  d.device_name
ORDER BY
  avg_flow DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_device_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) as device_count
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list
GROUP BY
  status

datasets.name: ds_filter_sites
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  site_code
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list
WHERE
  site_code IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  site_code

datasets.name: ds_filter_status
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  status
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.device_list
ORDER BY
  status

datasets.name: ds_filter_alert_type
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  alert_type
FROM
  workspace.scada_cleaned.alerts
ORDER BY
  alert_type
